stem: When a permanent tooth cannot be immediately replanted, which storage medium is considered the best widely available option?
explanation: Milk is considered an excellent, readily available storage medium that helps maintain the viability of the root cells.
rationale: Look for a common household liquid that is biologically compatible.

optionExplanations.A: Milk is considered an excellent, readily available storage medium that helps maintain the viability of the root cells.
optionExplanations.B: Water is considered a last preference because its osmolarity is harmful to the cells on the root surface over time.
optionExplanations.C: Alcohol is a fixative and disinfectant that would immediately kill the living cells on the tooth root.
optionExplanations.D: Dry storage is the worst option for an avulsed tooth as it leads to rapid cell dehydration and death.

source.hint: Look for a common household liquid that is biologically compatible.
